_about: Biologic patent dates as the company states them in its latest 10-K. The Orange Book does not list BLA biologics and the Purple Book has no patents, so labels.py reads this file when a product has no orange_book_patents.csv. Each quote is verbatim (whitespace collapsed) from the page named; tests/needle/test_labels_protection.py checks every quote against data/corpus. 'expiry' keeps the precision the filing uses (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).
